title: Tori's Pack
description: This is a modpack for Tori's World, a private Minecraft server.
body:
# Tori's Pack

## The official modpack for Tori's World, a private multiplayer server.

Tori's Pack primarily focuses on quality of life improvements and additions to portions of the game that deserve to be more fleshed out.

### Origins

The __Origins Mod__ (More specifically [__Origins: Legacy__](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins-legacy)) allows players to spawn into the world as one of many different Origins with their own unique abilities and drawbacks.

### Enhanced Structures and Biomes

Structures such as Strongholds and Villages have been completely revamped to be more interesting, useful, and fun.

### Other Gameplay Changes:

This pack includes a handful of mods that improve certain base-game features, enhance the Nether and the End dimensions, introduce new mobs, and more.

Here's a small list of some of the game-changing mods that are included:
- [Echancement](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchancement)
- [End Villager Outpost](https://modrinth.com/mod/end-villager-outpost)
- [Farmer's Delight Refabricated](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated)
- [Friends&Foes](https://modrinth.com/mod/friends-and-foes)
  - [Flowery Mooblooms](https://modrinth.com/mod/friends-and-foes-flowery-mooblooms-fabric)
  - [Beekeeper Hut](https://modrinth.com/mod/friends-and-foes-beekeeper-hut-fabric)
- [Serene Seasons](https://modrinth.com/mod/serene-seasons)
  - [Serene Seasons Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/serene-seasons-plus)
- [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat)
- [Spyglass Astronomy](https://modrinth.com/mod/spyglass-astronomy)
- [Waystones](https://modrinth.com/mod/waystones)
